_: The Graded Response Action Plan schedule for NCR, as revised by the Commission for Air Quality Management on 21 November 2025. A POLICY SCHEDULE, not a reading: it changes when CAQM amends it and at no other time, which is why it is committed by hand and carries no fetch job. Every threshold below is stated in a Government of India press release, cited per row — this file holds no number that a reader cannot follow to its source.
authority: Commission for Air Quality Management in NCR and Adjoining Areas

pib-2192852.title: CAQM revises GRAP schedule, making it more stringent
pib-2192852.note: States Stage I 201-300, Stage II 301-400 and Stage III 401-450 as Delhi AQI ranges, and records the 21.11.2025 revision.

pib-2215738.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
pib-2215738.title: CAQM invokes 5-point action plan as per Stage-IV of extant GRAP in entire Delhi-NCR
pib-2215738.note: States Stage-IV, 'Severe+' Air Quality, as Delhi's AQI above 450. The 21.11.2025 revision release does not give Stage IV's trigger, so it is sourced here instead.
